_comment: Canonical ConsoleAudit document shape. The L5 Actuator is the authority - it writes ActionReceiptRecord documents to this collection after executing governed actions. Console audit records provide a tamper-evident trail of all governed mutations. A field mismatch breaks audit trails and compliance reporting.

console_audit._description: Action receipt record written by the L5 Actuator after executing a governed action. Provides a tamper-evident audit trail. The document ID is the transaction_id from the GovernanceEnvelope. Serialized from ActionReceiptRecord (internal/models/gateway.go).

transaction_id.description: Transaction ID from the originating GovernanceEnvelope. Used as the document ID.

transaction_hash.description: Hash of the governance transaction. Computed from the envelope canonical form.

operator_id.description: Operator ID from the GovernanceEnvelope that submitted the action.

operator_session_id.description: Operator session ID from the GovernanceEnvelope. Binds the action to a specific authenticated session.

action_type.description: Type of governed action executed. See constants.ActionType enum (e.g. 'execute_bash', 'kv_set', 'doc_set').

target_resource.description: Target resource of the action (e.g. 'localhost', collection name, KV key).

status.description: Execution status. Values: 'EXECUTION_STATUS_EXECUTING', 'EXECUTION_STATUS_COMPLETED', 'EXECUTION_STATUS_FAILED'. Written twice per action: once before execution (EXECUTING) and once after (COMPLETED or FAILED).

result_summary.description: Human-readable result summary. 'executing' for initial receipt, 'completed' or 'failed: {error}' for final receipt.

state_root_before.description: State root hash before execution. Empty if StateRootProvider is unavailable.

state_root_after.description: State root hash after execution. Empty if StateRootProvider is unavailable or for initial EXECUTING receipt.

l2_valid.description: Whether L2 (multi-sig tribunal) verification passed. True when L2 was required and valid; false when required and failed; false when not required.

l3_valid.description: Whether L3 (human approval) verification passed. True when L3 was required and valid; false when required and failed; false when not required.

signature.description: ED25519 signature over the canonicalized ActionReceipt payload from the Actuator signing key.

signer_key_id.description: Key ID of the Actuator signing key used to sign the receipt.

executed_at.description: When the action was executed by the Actuator (UTC, ISO 8601). Derived from ExecutedAtUnixMs.

timestamp.description: When the receipt record was written to the audit store (UTC, ISO 8601). Set by LogReceipt at write time.
